style: server monitoring dashboard, dark UI, monospace type (Menlo)
tech: inline SVG (single 896x896 SVG page, headless Chrome)
conflict_summary: Needles/fills show alpha-01 38, beta-02 15, gamma-03 92; in conflict the readouts under the gauges say alpha-01 15%, beta-02 92%, gamma-03 38%.

data.scale: arc 0-100, end labels '0' and '100' only, unlabeled ticks every 10
data.position_check: argmax is never the first card and argmin never the last card, for either cue
data.hosts_table_check: every number in the hosts table has argmax alpha-01 / argmin gamma-03; needles give gamma-03/beta-02, readouts beta-02/alpha-01, so name->row-number binding hits neither cue
data.design_deviation: DESIGN.md plan: visual alpha 92 / beta 38 / gamma 15, q3 on alpha-01, q4 on gamma-03. Built: 38/15/92, q3 on gamma-03, q4 on alpha-01, so card position is not a cue (see make.py docstring).
data.read_value_note: q4 conflict: the visual answer 38 is printed as the readout of gamma-03; a 'visual' hit can be a misbind to that card. A needle-only estimate (~40) scores 'neither'. Analysis: report conflict-q4 'visual' hits separately as 'possible misbind' and keep them out of the visual-vs-text headline (unavoidable with a 3-value permutation).
